# AdaptiveGraphDiffusion

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A diffusion mechanism on graphs where the propagation strength or kernel is learned or adjusted per node/edge based on data characteristics. Allows the network to adapt to heterogeneous spatial-spectral structures, improving generalization in dynamic or non-uniform topologies.
